scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --test "test/**/*.ts"
scripts.start: pnpm run build && fastify start -l info dist/app.js
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "TypeScript,App" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "pnpm run watch" "pnpm run dev:start"
